S.FORM: == kakiliman == Pay-ney kanatal aidangan "Si-pang-ya a kamu, "Parque Nacional Torres del Paine' u imi Cin-ta aidangan nu kanatal "Paine" cusulit makay In-ti-an a kamu "sumilaway a imi, hamin u kanatal aidangan masaiyuk nu sumilaway malinganguay diheb kuli a sauwasc a singangan. :Parque Nacional Torres del Paine)又譯為青塔國家公園,"Paine" . nilaculan tini i nutimulan nu C-li cacay nu kanalalay aidangan, lalabu micapi tu An-s-san atu timul Tay-pin-yang atu sikuliay a bayu, kikasumad ku la'cus nu demiad, kanatal aidangan angangan a adihan izaw ku Pay-ney-ta "Las Torres", Pay-ney kalimucu' "Los Cuernos" Hwa-kow-ku "Valle Francés", Now-ten-se-al-te kuli a taku "Lano Nordenskjöld" atu taneng maazih ku kuli a byu' nu abu taku ＆ abu kuli a sauwac "Lago Grey & Glacier Grey" imahini u May-ce-lun-Ce-li tinulay cudetay a kitizaan ku mikuwanay, 112 kung-li ku laed tu Na-ta-lay-s a minatu, patizeng i 1959 a mihca 5 a bulad 13 a demiad, u hekal 2,422 pin-hwng-kung-li. :百內塔(Las Torres),百內角(Los Cuernos),法國谷(Valle Francés),諾登捨爾德冰川湖(Lago Nordenskjöld) . milekakawa ku Nan-mey-cow mikinsa tu nisulitan a ngangan hawsa "Pay-ney-ye kanatal aidangan" "Parque Nacional Torres del Paine" lalid sa tahkal i nuayawan nu maku, anu caay kinsaen sa kaliyuhan, kins han sa katawidan azih han sanu Pay-ney aidangan nu singanganay nu Nan-mey-cow, salungan ku hekal u kapahay a piculilan. "(Parque Nacional Torres del Paine) . paymihcaan masulup ku malebut emang ku manamuhay tu nu tahakay a piliwkuay tayni. micidek ku manamuhay mukayakay tu buyu' sakay Ow-mey a tademaw hawsa, sakamu sa ku Pay-ne i kauzipan kanca a kinacacay tayni mizizaw u kanamuhan nu miculilay kuyni a zazan. anu "ten-kong-c-cin" "u-yu-ni" Ya-cow a tademaw tayza i Nan-mey kanca u pizunbayan a katayzan. uyza "Pay-ney kanatal aidangan" uyza nu miliwkuay nu Ow-mey kanca u pizunbanay a piidangan . uyni nisulitan amisiwkay tuu liwliw nu Pay-ney kanatal aidangan, hicaen mizunbay tu cacililan atu pilaminan. atu tayza i kanatal aidangan a saculilan atu labu singanganay aazihan nu Pay-ney kanatal aidangan sibalucu' a paazih tu kawaw nu Pay-ney kanatal aidangan. zayhan tayza Pay-ne kanatal aidangan cacay a demiad malikeluh ku balad maluyuh tu ku sangaw nupades, sisa sazikuzay nayi' ku malaheciay a Pay-ney kanatal aidanganay "W" piculilan a zazan, tayza dada' Pay-ne kanatal aidangan satipanay a "Ke-iye kuli a sauwac i capi misaculiculil. zuma mipangangan tu Pay-ne kanatal aidanganay a Day Tour makalikut mikinaul tu hekal nu Pay-ne kanatal aidanganay. Ce-li in-in apiaziha, u sakaydihan aku miazih saayaway micuzuh tu Pay-ne kanatal aidangan atu bu-he-cye kanatal. Pay-ne kanatal aidangan uyza mahica u piliwkuan nu tademaw a N a kakitiza pisingkiwan hina singanganay. kanahatu miliwku amana paceba sat u nipisingkiw tu tau, nika tadeng makazebec a katuud ku micukelay, tatenga' kikatinengan ku tau. Nutimilan nu Nan-bey Patagonia kakitizaan u sakatuluay a piliwkuan nu Nan-mey, acaay piales kaku miliwku tu Pay-ne kanatal aidangan. u dumiad ku han, maalesaytu muculil tuya micidekay nu mitaliyukay mukayakay tu buyu' a zazan "El Circuito / The Paine Circuit" tuwaca kinapina a panukas, nipangangan "W" a zazan mukayakay tu buyu' caay kadyum a malaheci, taneng palawad han tu tusa tulu a demiad i piidangan mipili' tu ngatu a muculil. (El Circuito / The Paine Circuit), . satim piliwkuan aku tu saayaway a ngatu i A-ken-tinyadah ku kaetel tu demiad, palawpes tju demiad a mizunbay tayza i Nan-ci atu amalimad tayza i Nan-ciay a balunga, sazikuzay mapacici' taneng makay capiay a niyazu' Puerto Natales dada' milihiza cacay a demiad a sakaput tayza. uyni u tanengay tu kasatimad, mumul tu sananal maudad. hemhem ku balucu' aku mikacaw tu papiliwkuay a basu, sayawan a pikacawan pakulisiw ku uzip miazih tu likutay nu aaidangan nu tahakay a buhang Cueva del Milodon "Milodon Cave", namaazih ku malecaday angangan nika u malawpesay tu a ukak nu aadupan, zikuz tatenga tu micumud tu liwliw nu aidangan. Pay-ne kanatal aidangan tatenga' masuped tu ku tahakay a hanhan, ihm picumuda capi tu pipasasumaad malikeluh ku May-cow a tow ayam "ñandú / rhea", sizi-tow "guanaco" abu kuyu "grey fox" buyu'ay aadupan atu pinaay lamangan nu buyu'ay a ayam. (ñandú / rhea), . Ce-li Pay-ne kanatal aidangan, u singanganay nu kitakit katayzaan nu mukayakayay tu buyu', katuud ku misasingay caay kapiculil, cacay a tatukian muculil yadah tu ku nisasingan tu aazihan, muneng I kanatal aidangan, caay pikuwan apina a tatukian ku pisasing. 11 a bulad katukuh zuma a mihcaan tu 3 a bulad, u piliwkuwn, tanayu' ku demiad apuyu' ku sandeb, tabaki ku bali, pilabinan atumicaliw tu kazizeng caay kadayum amitin sangaleb u Pay-ney" kanihalan atu kacelemad a tatukian tanayu', patineku tu 12 abulad tusazikuzay kanihalan tu 05:30, kaceleman tu 22:10, tulu a bulad malingatu, 4-5 a bulad tu balangbangan, yadah ku sumanahay a papah. 6-8 a bulad, katukuh9 a bulad tuteban nu kasienawan, huntu adidi' ku bali, madayum masasing ku mabelihay a adingu, izaw henay ku tabakiay a sakapahay, mautang ku kanihal, matabal mucelem, sisa lihalay mkisasing, mahiniay 6 a bulad tahlkal ku cilal tu 09:50 a tatukian, kaceleman tu 17:50 a tatukian mamin tu misasing tu kanihalal kapah tu taluwkang malahuk, namamim malakuh mihibang katukuh tulu sepap a tatukian tahkal misasing tu kacelemad, mamin misasing tu kacelemad kapah tu taluma' malabi. 9 a bulad malingatu, 10 a bulad, 11 a b ulad katukuh 12 a bulad tu teban u sadingsingan a puu',kinapina tu tayza i Patagonia pasasing, makay 8 a bulad katukuh 6 a bulad natayza tu amin, caay nay katayza i 7 a bulad, pay puu'an izaw ku kasamicidekay. pasabalucu' muenengay i kanatal aidangan, anucaay likut nu kanatal aidanganay aVilla Serrano, anuangangan u nipasasing hawsa, amana pipili' muneng i Puerto Natales, zayhan sademiad a izaw ku pananukasay tu setat a tatukian nu saculilan. Mjuneng I kanatal aida ngan kanca a izaw ku saculian a kazizeng, caay kakatuud ku micaliw tu kazizeng,katuud ku mibaway tu kazizeng, nayi' ku kazizeng ahicaen muculil. micumud tu aidangan ayaw amicunus tu kapahay a nanum /hica, zayhan labu nu aidangan nayay ku pacakayay tu tuud,matekes ku nanum, Patagonia maacak, amaydih kisu tu nanum. Pay-neykanatal aidangn u sasasingan mitaliyuk tu kalimucu' nu Pay-ney,tabakiay a Pay-ney buyu' atu Pay-ney tulu a ta, patatungus tu masazumaay pasasing tu aazihan, demidemiad mizunbay amin tu zumaay kitizaan tu kanihalan atu kacelemad. Pay-ney a nisasingan hicaen amatineng tu kanihalan atu kaceleman? tada madayum, anu u likat makay Kawana takawili, u sananal kuyza, anu kawili pasayza i kawanan, u kaceleman kuyza. zayhan misasing tu kalimucu' nu Pay-ney, tabakiay Pay-ney a kalimucu' hatu u makayza i timul pasaamis, sisa sananalay a likat makay kawanan takawili, Pay-ney san-ta sangaleb kapah akatinengan tu, maydih maazih ku kapahay a Pay-ney san-ta kanca makay wali tasatip, anu izaw ku cilal madil ku sumanaay madil ku takuliyaway, kanca u kanihalan, zayhan kaceleman macubelis ku lkikat , mala nisaitan a adingu.

S.FORM: == kakiliman == Pay-ney kanatal aidangan "Si-pang-ya a kamu, "Parque Nacional Torres del Paine' u imi Cin-ta aidangan nu kanatal "Paine" cusulit makay In-ti-an a kamu "sumilaway a imi, hamin u kanatal aidangan masaiyuk nu sumilaway malinganguay diheb kuli a sauwasc a singangan. :Parque Nacional Torres del Paine)又譯為青塔國家公園,"Paine" . nilaculan tini i nutimulan nu C-li cacay nu kanalalay aidangan, lalabu micapi tu An-s-san atu timul Tay-pin-yang atu sikuliay a bayu, kikasumad ku la'cus nu demiad, kanatal aidangan angangan a adihan izaw ku Pay-ney-ta "Las Torres", Pay-ney kalimucu' "Los Cuernos" Hwa-kow-ku "Valle Frances", Now-ten-se-al-te kuli a taku "Lano Nordenskjöld" atu taneng maazih ku kuli a byu' nu abu taku ＆ abu kuli a sauwac "Lago Grey & Glacier Grey" imahini u May-ce-lun-Ce-li tinulay cudetay a kitizaan ku mikuwanay, 112 kung-li ku laed tu Na-ta-lay-s a minatu, patizeng i 1959 a mihca 5 a bulad 13 a demiad, u hekal 2,422 pin-hwng-kung-li. :百內塔(Las Torres),百內角(Los Cuernos),法國谷(Valle Frances),諾登捨爾德冰川湖(Lago Nordenskjöld) . milekakawa ku Nan-mey-cow mikinsa tu nisulitan a ngangan hawsa "Pay-ney-ye kanatal aidangan" "Parque Nacional Torres del Paine" lalid sa tahkal i nuayawan nu maku, anu caay kinsaen sa kaliyuhan, kins han sa katawidan azih han sanu Pay-ney aidangan nu singanganay nu Nan-mey-cow, salungan ku hekal u kapahay a piculilan. "(Parque Nacional Torres del Paine) . paymihcaan masulup ku malebut emang ku manamuhay tu nu tahakay a piliwkuay tayni. micidek ku manamuhay mukayakay tu buyu' sakay Ow-mey a tademaw hawsa, sakamu sa ku Pay-ne i kauzipan kanca a kinacacay tayni mizizaw u kanamuhan nu miculilay kuyni a zazan. anu "ten-kong-c-cin" "u-yu-ni" Ya-cow a tademaw tayza i Nan-mey kanca u pizunbayan a katayzan. uyza "Pay-ney kanatal aidangan" uyza nu miliwkuay nu Ow-mey kanca u pizunbanay a piidangan . uyni nisulitan amisiwkay tuu liwliw nu Pay-ney kanatal aidangan, hicaen mizunbay tu cacililan atu pilaminan. atu tayza i kanatal aidangan a saculilan atu labu singanganay aazihan nu Pay-ney kanatal aidangan sibalucu' a paazih tu kawaw nu Pay-ney kanatal aidangan. zayhan tayza Pay-ne kanatal aidangan cacay a demiad malikeluh ku balad maluyuh tu ku sangaw nupades, sisa sazikuzay nayi' ku malaheciay a Pay-ney kanatal aidanganay "W" piculilan a zazan, tayza dada' Pay-ne kanatal aidangan satipanay a "Ke-iye kuli a sauwac i capi misaculiculil. zuma mipangangan tu Pay-ne kanatal aidanganay a Day Tour makalikut mikinaul tu hekal nu Pay-ne kanatal aidanganay. Ce-li in-in apiaziha, u sakaydihan aku miazih saayaway micuzuh tu Pay-ne kanatal aidangan atu bu-he-cye kanatal. Pay-ne kanatal aidangan uyza mahica u piliwkuan nu tademaw a N a kakitiza pisingkiwan hina singanganay. kanahatu miliwku amana paceba sat u nipisingkiw tu tau, nika tadeng makazebec a katuud ku micukelay, tatenga' kikatinengan ku tau. Nutimilan nu Nan-bey Patagonia kakitizaan u sakatuluay a piliwkuan nu Nan-mey, acaay piales kaku miliwku tu Pay-ne kanatal aidangan. u dumiad ku han, maalesaytu muculil tuya micidekay nu mitaliyukay mukayakay tu buyu' a zazan "El Circuito / The Paine Circuit" tuwaca kinapina a panukas, nipangangan "W" a zazan mukayakay tu buyu' caay kadyum a malaheci, taneng palawad han tu tusa tulu a demiad i piidangan mipili' tu ngatu a muculil. (El Circuito / The Paine Circuit), . satim piliwkuan aku tu saayaway a ngatu i A-ken-tinyadah ku kaetel tu demiad, palawpes tju demiad a mizunbay tayza i Nan-ci atu amalimad tayza i Nan-ciay a balunga, sazikuzay mapacici' taneng makay capiay a niyazu' Puerto Natales dada' milihiza cacay a demiad a sakaput tayza. uyni u tanengay tu kasatimad, mumul tu sananal maudad. hemhem ku balucu' aku mikacaw tu papiliwkuay a basu, sayawan a pikacawan pakulisiw ku uzip miazih tu likutay nu aaidangan nu tahakay a buhang Cueva del Milodon "Milodon Cave", namaazih ku malecaday angangan nika u malawpesay tu a ukak nu aadupan, zikuz tatenga tu micumud tu liwliw nu aidangan. Pay-ne kanatal aidangan tatenga' masuped tu ku tahakay a hanhan, ihm picumuda capi tu pipasasumaad malikeluh ku May-cow a tow ayam "ñandu / rhea", sizi-tow "guanaco" abu kuyu "grey fox" buyu'ay aadupan atu pinaay lamangan nu buyu'ay a ayam. (ñandu / rhea), . Ce-li Pay-ne kanatal aidangan, u singanganay nu kitakit katayzaan nu mukayakayay tu buyu', katuud ku misasingay caay kapiculil, cacay a tatukian muculil yadah tu ku nisasingan tu aazihan, muneng I kanatal aidangan, caay pikuwan apina a tatukian ku pisasing. 11 a bulad katukuh zuma a mihcaan tu 3 a bulad, u piliwkuwn, tanayu' ku demiad apuyu' ku sandeb, tabaki ku bali, pilabinan atumicaliw tu kazizeng caay kadayum amitin sangaleb u Pay-ney" kanihalan atu kacelemad a tatukian tanayu', patineku tu 12 abulad tusazikuzay kanihalan tu 05:30, kaceleman tu 22:10, tulu a bulad malingatu, 4-5 a bulad tu balangbangan, yadah ku sumanahay a papah. 6-8 a bulad, katukuh9 a bulad tuteban nu kasienawan, huntu adidi' ku bali, madayum masasing ku mabelihay a adingu, izaw henay ku tabakiay a sakapahay, mautang ku kanihal, matabal mucelem, sisa lihalay mkisasing, mahiniay 6 a bulad tahlkal ku cilal tu 09:50 a tatukian, kaceleman tu 17:50 a tatukian mamin tu misasing tu kanihalal kapah tu taluwkang malahuk, namamim malakuh mihibang katukuh tulu sepap a tatukian tahkal misasing tu kacelemad, mamin misasing tu kacelemad kapah tu taluma' malabi. 9 a bulad malingatu, 10 a bulad, 11 a b ulad katukuh 12 a bulad tu teban u sadingsingan a puu',kinapina tu tayza i Patagonia pasasing, makay 8 a bulad katukuh 6 a bulad natayza tu amin, caay nay katayza i 7 a bulad, pay puu'an izaw ku kasamicidekay. pasabalucu' muenengay i kanatal aidangan, anucaay likut nu kanatal aidanganay aVilla Serrano, anuangangan u nipasasing hawsa, amana pipili' muneng i Puerto Natales, zayhan sademiad a izaw ku pananukasay tu setat a tatukian nu saculilan. Mjuneng I kanatal aida ngan kanca a izaw ku saculian a kazizeng, caay kakatuud ku micaliw tu kazizeng,katuud ku mibaway tu kazizeng, nayi' ku kazizeng ahicaen muculil. micumud tu aidangan ayaw amicunus tu kapahay a nanum /hica, zayhan labu nu aidangan nayay ku pacakayay tu tuud,matekes ku nanum, Patagonia maacak, amaydih kisu tu nanum. Pay-neykanatal aidangn u sasasingan mitaliyuk tu kalimucu' nu Pay-ney,tabakiay a Pay-ney buyu' atu Pay-ney tulu a ta, patatungus tu masazumaay pasasing tu aazihan, demidemiad mizunbay amin tu zumaay kitizaan tu kanihalan atu kacelemad. Pay-ney a nisasingan hicaen amatineng tu kanihalan atu kaceleman? tada madayum, anu u likat makay Kawana takawili, u sananal kuyza, anu kawili pasayza i kawanan, u kaceleman kuyza. zayhan misasing tu kalimucu' nu Pay-ney, tabakiay Pay-ney a kalimucu' hatu u makayza i timul pasaamis, sisa sananalay a likat makay kawanan takawili, Pay-ney san-ta sangaleb kapah akatinengan tu, maydih maazih ku kapahay a Pay-ney san-ta kanca makay wali tasatip, anu izaw ku cilal madil ku sumanaay madil ku takuliyaway, kanca u kanihalan, zayhan kaceleman macubelis ku lkikat , mala nisaitan a adingu.
